title: Abba bar Binyamin
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He lived in Eretz Yisrael, in the city of Arbel (in the book Kaftor va-Feraḥ, the distance of Arbel is given as about half an hour from Tiberias). In [Jerusalem Talmud Shevi’it 6:3](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Sheviit.6.3.5), Rabbi Abbahu came to Arbel and was received by Abba bar Binyamin. We have already said that bet and mem are interchanged, so it is not far-fetched to say that he is the one mentioned in [Gittin 29b](https://www.sefaria.org/Gittin.29b.9-12) under the name Abba bar Manyumi: someone sent a get via an agent and instructed him to give the get to Abba bar Manyumi, because he knows the woman. When the agent arrived, he found Rabbi Abbahu, Rabbi Chanina bar Pappa, and Rabbi Yitzchak Nappacha, and they said to him, 'Entrust your agency before us; when Abba bar Manyumi comes, we will give it to him.' But it is not reasonable to say that he is Abba the son of Rav Binyamin bar Ḥiyya, since the latter is always mentioned as 'the son of Rav Binyamin'; likewise, this is not the Abba bar Manyumi whom we always find together with the Babylonian amoraim.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked Yerushalmi says Rabbi Abbahu was received at Arbel by Abba bar Binyamin. Hyman suggests that the bet and mem variation could connect this name to Manyumi.

The linked Bavli gives Abba bar Minyumi and the competing versions of the argument over the agent’s authority. Rav Safra is present with the three sages. Hyman explicitly distinguishes two Babylonian namesakes.
